entry.title: Introducing the AI Chip Imports explorer
entry.summary: Our explorer uses customs records to estimate national shares. Since 2022, 72% of AI compute has ended up in the US and about 10% in China, including chips China makes itself.

entry.title: Open-weight models trail closed models in cyber capabilities by 6–7 months
entry.summary: Z.ai’s GLM-5.3 is the top open-weight model on Epoch’s Cyber ECI, scoring where the closed-weight frontier stood 6–7 months earlier.

entry.title: AI systems are improving rapidly at Slay the Spire and its sequel
entry.summary: Months ago, frontier models could barely beat Slay the Spire. Now they win 90%+ at the easiest setting and up to 20% at the hardest. Results from Epoch AI’s new SpireClimb benchmark.

entry.title: Can AI automate Epoch?
entry.summary: Frontier models can handle well-defined tasks reliably, but fail in the more open-ended aspects that prevent full work automation. Explore Epoch AI's Automation Reports: realistic, open-ended tasks taken directly from our work, manually graded by our own standards.

entry.title: Can AI automate AI R&D yet?
EBR-bench update
entry.summary: Updates on EBR-bench, Epoch AI’s benchmark that tests models’ ability to learn from experience. GPT-6 Astra hit a perfect score on over half its EBR-bench attempts by exploiting one overpowered card, which we now ban. Plus multi-agent scaffold results.

entry.title: US adults are no more likely to face cyber incidents than when Claude Fable 5 launched
entry.summary: June and September polls from Epoch AI/Ipsos show no detectable increase in the share of US adults experiencing cyber incidents

entry.title: China is more exposed to semiconductor supply-chain disruptions than the US
entry.summary: China is 2.7× as exposed to semiconductor supply shocks as the US, Epoch AI estimates. Epoch traces chips through input-output tables to model the impact of a Taiwan shock and decoupling.

entry.title: How do Chinese AI companies make money?
entry.summary: China's six leading AI firms earn about 10% of OpenAI and Anthropic's combined AI revenue. Epoch AI examines their five revenue streams: consumer apps, model access, enterprise and government solutions, licensing fees, and indirect monetization through cloud and advertising.

entry.title: Coding-agent spending by OpenAI researchers is doubling roughly every month
entry.summary: OpenAI researchers’ coding-agent usage, valued at API prices, has recently been doubling roughly every month, according to breakpoint fits.
